note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997); original in English; soldiers and workers are both dimorphic, each treated in a single section; biological information is placed under 'Other'; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Major soldier body length 8.0–9.20 mm, mandibles stout and short, mandible/head length ratio 0.45–0.49; minor soldier mandibles slender, ratio 0.52–0.55; alate compound eyes large and markedly protruding, ocellus–compound eye distance 0.02–0.10 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule golden brown to reddish brown; antennae brownish; mandibles dark reddish brown to black; thorax yellowish brown; abdomen slightly paler than thorax. Head and thorax very sparsely pilose; labrum with long hairs on the sides and one or two pairs of hairs below the translucent apex; pronotum with only a few small hairs on the anterior margin; meso- and metanotum without hairs; abdomen with several hairs. Body length 8.0–9.2 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, sides narrowed anteriorly (length to mandibular base 3.24–4.0 mm, maximum width 2.36–3.42 mm, maximum width/length ratio 0.76–0.88, cephalic constriction index, i.e. width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio, 0.60–0.63). Fontanelle small, minute, circular, situated slightly in front of the middle of the head. Compound eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 17–18-segmented; segment 3 about 1.5 times segment 2; segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Labrum triangular, with a translucent apex. Mandibles short, stout and powerful (length 1.42–2.02 mm), less than half the head length. Left mandible with tooth processes on the basal half; right mandible without tooth processes. Postmentum long, subquadrate, with a long shaft or waist (length 2.04–2.86 mm, maximum width 0.62–0.95 mm, waist width 0.43–0.64 mm). Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped; anterior and posterior margins both distinctly concave; lateral margins rounded (length 1.05–1.35 mm, width 1.93–2.60 mm). Minor soldier: head capsule pale yellowish brown; labrum and antennae pale brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; body paler than head capsule. Cephalic pilosity very sparse, with one pair of hairs posteriorly and one or two pairs behind the anteclypeus; pronotum with a few short hairs on the anterior margin; meso- and metanotum without hairs. Body length 5.0–7.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate and slightly oval (length to mandibular base 1.82–2.43 mm, maximum width 1.43–2.0 mm, maximum width/length ratio 0.76–0.83); sides narrowed anteriorly (width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio 0.59–0.62). Fontanelle minute, circular, at the middle of the head. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum triangular, with a translucent triangular, dome-shaped point at the apex. Mandibles slender and straight (length 1.14–1.50 mm), slightly more than half the head length; left mandible with several tooth processes on the basal half, right mandible without tooth processes. Postmentum subquadrate (length 1.14–1.61 mm, minimum width 0.41–0.57 mm). Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped (length 0.60–0.88 mm, width 0.95–1.13 mm); anterior and posterior margins both incised; lateral margins rounded. Mesonotum narrower than pronotum, metanotum wider than mesonotum and narrower than pronotum; lateral margins of both rounded.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head capsule yellowish brown, with a circular translucent median dorsal fontanellar plate; body whitish to pale yellow. Pilosity sparse. Head capsule circular (length to mandibular base 1.11–1.73 mm, maximum width 1.79–2.03 mm). Compound eyes transparent, circular. Ocelli absent. Antennae 17–18-segmented; segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2; segment 4 very short. Postclypeus paler than head capsule, inflated, less than half as long as wide (length 0.30–0.33 mm, width 0.83–0.88 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; anterior and posterior margins incised (length 0.60–0.70 mm, width 0.95–1.13 mm). Minor worker: as the major worker but smaller, antennae 17-segmented. Body length 4.5–5.5 mm, head length to mandibular base 1.07–1.10 mm, maximum head width 1.35–1.43 mm, pronotum width 0.80–0.93 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark reddish brown; antennae brownish; postclypeus and labrum yellowish brown; pronotum brown, with a slightly paler T-shaped mark and humeral spots; abdomen and legs brownish; wings pale yellowish brown. Head and body sparsely pilose, wings densely pilose. Body length with wings 23.0–30.0 mm, without wings 12.0–14.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandibular base 1.72–2.39 mm, maximum width including compound eyes 2.45–2.80 mm). Fontanelle small, slightly raised, on the middle of the head dorsum. Compound eyes large, strongly protruding (maximum diameter 0.79–0.93 mm, minimum diameter 0.64–0.80 mm). Ocelli broadly oval, large (major diameter 0.32–0.45 mm, minor diameter 0.25–0.36 mm), close to the compound eye (ocellus–compound eye distance 0.02–0.10 mm). Antennae 19-segmented; segment 3 nearly as long as segment 2; segment 4 shorter. Postclypeus inflated, with one or two pairs of hairs; length slightly less than half its width. Pronotum nearly semicircular; as wide as the head including compound eyes (length 1.33–1.58 mm, maximum width 2.23–2.75 mm); anterior margin straight or slightly incurved, concavity indistinct; posterior margin weakly incised. Wings long, pilose; pale brown, forewing length 20.0–25.0 mm; micropilosity in 7–8 rows on the costa and 2–3 rows on the posterior margin, with small tubercles on the veins near the apex.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: A mound-building species, the mound dome-shaped and multi-chambered; its mounds, fungus combs and royal chambers are described in the literature. It damages various plants and trees, including sugarcane, rubber and coconut, and also attacks paper, clothing and structural timber indoors.
